title: Closet-Dex
body:
This was a student defined project meant to teach students about SCRUM practics, as well as working on a software development team. For this project we were split into groups of 4-5 students, and were tasked with generating a application idea and developing it using SCRUM practices.

In this project my team began with idea generation and found a user need to manage closet and clothing items. Further we decided that we wanted to add additional functionality such as allowing users to create new outfits from within the app.

This was a browser based application, and required skills involving, Web-Development, HTML, PHP, and CSS for the development of the web side. These were used to create an application that was capable of smooth user interaction. The PHP code was primarily used for interfacing with a backend server database that managed user outfits; this server database was then managed using MySQL code.

Through the course of the project the team also followed a SCRUM format, using sprints to break up work, defining goals using use cases, as well as assinging stories to accomplish the goals defined with use cases.
